thesis.core: Core waste-to-energy operations continue to compound with strong cash conversion, rising grid power and heat output, and a formal 60%+ payout framework; however, headline revenue growth is inflated by low-margin construction revenue and the balance sheet is becoming more leveraged as the company funds a new project cycle.
thesis.variant_wedge: The business is higher quality than the headline construction-mix dilution suggests because waste-treatment gross margin remains above 50% and operating cash flow exceeds attributable profit. The offset is that debt, capex and a planned up-to-RMB1bn convertible financing must earn acceptable returns before the current defensive-growth premium is fully justified.
thesis.normalized_earnings_basis: Use 2026E normalized EPS bear/base/bull of RMB0.29/RMB0.32/RMB0.36, anchored to H1 EPS RMB0.1547, H1 attributable profit RMB227.72m, current six-broker consensus near RMB0.32, and the current project ramp.

operating_and_financial_quality.judgment: Cash conversion is strong and core operating economics remain attractive, but capex and financing intensity are rising faster than equity.

capital_and_shareholder_return.financing_purpose: Project investment plus working-capital / bank-loan optimization.
capital_and_shareholder_return.dilution_risk: Potential future conversion is not included in 2026 basic EPS; dilution and financing-return risk are reflected in the bear case and valuation multiple.
capital_and_shareholder_return.payout_policy: 2024-2028 annual cash distributions not less than 60% of attributable net profit when conditions are met.

normalized_earnings_basis.rationale: Base follows H1 run-rate and current consensus; bear captures leverage/dilution and project-ramp risk.

catalysts: New waste-to-energy projects and acquired capacity ramp on schedule with stable utilization.
Grid-power output and industrial heat sales continue to grow faster than waste tonnage through efficiency gains.
Convertible-funded projects earn returns above the incremental funding cost while leverage stabilizes.
Operating cash conversion remains above normalized earnings and the 60%+ payout framework is maintained.
kill_thesis: Project commissioning or utilization materially misses plan, reducing the expected 2027 earnings step-up.
Waste-treatment fees, power tariffs or subsidy collection deteriorate materially.
Receivables, debt and capex rise faster than operating cash generation for a sustained period.
Convertible financing creates dilution without a corresponding ROIC uplift.
Core waste-treatment margin or cash conversion deteriorates enough to negate the defensive-quality thesis.
